title: Story with conflicting acceptance criteria
measures: conflict raised as an inconsistency finding

story.summary: Shopper sees the shipping cost in the cart
story.description:
As a shopper I want to know the shipping cost before checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Orders with a subtotal over 50 EUR ship for free.
- Orders with a subtotal under 100 EUR pay a flat shipping fee of 4.99 EUR.
- The shipping cost is shown in the cart summary before checkout.

acceptance_criteria.text: Orders with a subtotal over 50 EUR ship for free.
Orders with a subtotal under 100 EUR pay a flat shipping fee of 4.99 EUR.
The shipping cost is shown in the cart summary before checkout.

expected_findings.why: AC-1 and AC-2 overlap for subtotals between 50 and 100 EUR

expected_blocked.why: the fee in the overlap range is contradictory
